Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Bargain trip mode now requests Lifestream's market-board shortcut after warping to Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Added a TravelingToMarketBoard trip state before WaitingForMarketBoard. If the shortcut does not open the Market Board automatically, AutoBuy waits near the Market Board and prompts for manual selection.
